execution_backend: local MLX, sequential arms and sequential cases; no concurrent loaded models
matched_protocol_requirements: Both arms receive identical literal ordered input files and the same current native runtime, authority, binder limit and action limits.
One persistent full proof state; retain ordered open goals and aliases. No heuristic action, fallback proof, hidden retry or theorem repair.
Use each trained prompt/token mask and disclose exact differences; neither prompt receives expected outcomes, gold actions, source proof logs or countermodels.
Pin runner, provider, native files, model/base/tokenizer/adapter artifacts and actual model environment. Preserve actual loading and final-custody evidence.
Each arm runs in a separate process. No parallel MLX models. External case kill includes model loading; cooperative model deadline is 300 seconds.
Historical model old training-specific mask/prompt differences must be recorded. If greedy mask support is unavailable, do not silently compare a beam arm as identical decoding.
admission_requirements: Every requested ID appears exactly once in each arm and matches literal theorem hash and its input file pin.

Both panels must be complete; distinguish infrastructure error, native input rejection, model timeout, invalid tactic and genuine nonproof. Infrastructure/admission failure makes the matched comparison incomplete.
Model-inference claim requires actual fresh model execution and nonzero actual model call count. A saved-provider fixture or replay cannot earn model proof credit.

Positive proof credit requires actual strict decoded actions with no repair; native closure and a fresh independent replay of identical actions against the original admitted theorem; no imports, no classical mode; source/policy finalization succeeds.
Independent replay must confirm original theorem, complete trace, every action, QED, authority and native source identity. Process/session IDs need not be equal.
False controls require input admission. Input rejection is not successful soundness control. Any native accepted proof of an expected false formula is an immediate stop and investigation.
Timeouts and nonproofs are not refutations and never become positive wins. Unmeasured counters must be null rather than invented.

metrics.primary_false_controls: Report number admitted and any accepted proofs, separately from positive success.
metrics.regression: Report six prior cases separately; preserve historical positive successes; do not combine with primary denominator.
metrics.efficiency: Report actual calls, decision tokens, case wall time and timeouts separately per arm; no estimated throughput claim.
metrics.not_allowed: No accuracy number dominated by passing false controls. No held-out/generalization or statistical significance claim from this small exposed panel.

minimum_requirements: Both arms completed all 18 cases under sealed matched limits with valid provenance and required admission/replay/custody evidence.
At least one primary positive is genuinely proved by WMI only.
Zero accepted false-control proofs in either panel/arm.
No regression positive proved by historical arm is lost by WMI.
promotion_decision.if_requirements_fail: Do not automatically promote; report concrete losses, invalid runs or insufficient gain. Keep current default model unchanged.
promotion_decision.scope: A passing result supports a limited engineering promotion on this precommitted exposed panel, not broad mathematical superiority.

gold_access: Verifier process may read PRIVATE_EXPECTATIONS.json only after actual run output is sealed; model processes receive only model input file and runtime artifacts.
